subject: Web Development
title: Web Workers and Off-Main-Thread
description: A micro-lesson that makes Web Workers and Off-Main-Thread usable.

hook.text: JavaScript runs on a single thread. Heavy computation blocks rendering and user input.

buildup.text: Web Workers let you run scripts in background threads that don't block the main thread.

discovery.text: Complex calculations, data processing, and parsing can happen without freezing the interface.

twist.text: Workers can't touch the DOM directly. They communicate through messages, adding complexity.

climax.text: Moving work off the main thread is the only way to keep interactive responsiveness at scale.

punchline.text: Heavy work belongs in the background thread.

quiz.question: What limitation do Web Workers have?
